title: Rollback Preview
summary: Shows what a rollback reverts, what it can't undo and which versions it skips, then confirms by typing the target's name.
description: Rollback confirmation listing what reverts, what won't undo (irreversible migrations, data written since), the target's age and every newer version skipped. Confirms only when the target's name is typed, and calls out a different version's name instead of silently not matching.
catches: What stays: irreversible migrations and data written since, with consequences
Typed name that matches a different version ("v4" for "v40")
Case and whitespace differences, normalised ("V40 " matches "v40")
limits: Lists only what you pass; it cannot inspect your deploys or migrations
Typing a name proves attention, not authorization
a11y: Name input has a <label>, aria-invalid on a wrong version and a polite hint via aria-describedby
Enter in the input confirms when it matches
Sections use icons plus text counts; motion skipped under reduced motion
server: Authorize the rollback server-side and check that the target is still deployable (schema compatibility) before running it.
stops: Rollback skipped more versions than expected
